title: Qualify original Numerics immutable private NuGet release controller without publication
commitMessage: test: qualify Numerics immutable private release controller

contribution.summary: Qualify an original-only Numerics private NuGet release controller that pins F35 archive/DLL identity, IR and Quantities dependencies and refuses mismatched archives without publishing.
contribution.value: Compile the guarded controller and nonmutating qualification mode; retain exact F35 and F36 lineage, source hashes and dependent package hashes; record archive availability without claiming approval. Publication and independent readback stay separate.
debtChanges: RS169 succeeded on attempt 002 after an allocated failure; F36 proved disposable publication with fifteen binary probes, but its rebuilt archive differs from the original F35 package.
The only admissible original release is the F35 18313-byte Numerics archive with SHA-256 f8e50ed2..., a single exact IR dependency and transitive Quantities.
RS170 publishes nothing to NUGET_LOCAL, does not authorize owner release, public registry, installed rollback, other repositories or AURA D3.

RS170 first invocation was refused before attempt allocation by CS7036: PreparePublication requires an explicit CancellationToken when ignoreSubdirectories is supplied. The same pending run is corrected without releasing packages.
contribution.nextAction: After RS170 succeeds, request explicit owner authorization to publish only the physically verified original F35 archive, then perform independent private-feed readback.
